description: This file implements an in-memory WebSocket hub for broadcasting order status updates to connected clients. It maintains active WebSocket connections per order and provides methods to connect, disconnect, and broadcast messages.

classes.name: OrderUpdatesHub
classes.description: A class managing WebSocket connections for real-time order updates.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the hub with an empty connection dictionary and an asyncio lock.

methods.name: None connect(self, order_id: int, ws: WebSocket)
methods.description: Accepts a WebSocket connection and adds it to the list of active connections for a specific order.

methods.name: None disconnect(self, order_id: int, ws: WebSocket)
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket connection from the list of active connections for a specific order.

methods.name: None broadcast(self, order_id: int, payload: dict)
methods.description: Sends a message payload to all active WebSocket connections associated with a specific order.

ctags.name: broadcast
ctags.pattern: /^    async def broadcast(self, order_id: int, payload: dict) -> None:$/

ctags.name: connect
ctags.pattern: /^    async def connect(self, order_id: int, ws: WebSocket) -> None:$/

ctags.name: disconnect
ctags.pattern: /^    async def disconnect(self, order_id: int, ws: WebSocket) -> None:$/
